title: Safety aggregation and model pruning method and system based on multi-stage alliance chain

pse.problem: Secure federated learning settings face high security risks of privacy leakage due to sharing gradient information or model parameters in the alliance.
pse.solution_function: The invention proposes a secure aggregation method for multi-level consortium chains, which includes global parameter initialization, local model training, and encrypted gradient homomorphic aggregation steps. The method aims to protect data privacy while reducing communication complexity and ensuring integrity of the model aggregation results.
pse.solution_structure: The key components include global alliance chain, equity nodes (AN), aggregation node, secondary alliance chain, and data nodes (DN).
pse.solution_implementation: Equity nodes initialize model, training method, and parameters in the first-level alliance chain. They then designate a specific data node as an aggregation node for training. Each data node performs local training and encrypts the gradient results using homomorphic encryption. The aggregation node collects these encrypted gradients and performs a homomorphic aggregation operation. The equity node decrypts the aggregated result, releases it to the secondary alliance chain, and the process is repeated for multiple rounds until convergence.
pse.effect: The method reduces communication complexity and achieves comparable privacy protection to plain text while maintaining calculation and communication efficiency.
